fixes.explanation: You've got it, baker. The text says "As was his custom, Paul went into the synagogue…" (Acts 17:2). A custom is just a habit, and Paul has a good one. Mine? I check the oven every four minutes like the cookies might have packed up and moved out. They're STILL in there. They're ALWAYS in there. They have NOWHERE else to be!

problems.problem: The oven-door comparison is still a mild, predictable joke rather than a strong Papa Dorin laugh.
